results.title: Electrical contractors are using automation to protect response time and job capacity.

demo.sub: This demo focuses on a real-world electrical service call: classify urgency, collect missing details, and route the customer to the right next step.
demo.note: The point is not a chatbot novelty. It is a faster front door for jobs Billy Bob Electric already wants.

prompts.title: Emergency Triage Agent
prompts.subtitle: Classify incoming electrical requests
prompts.pre: You are the Emergency Dispatch Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Classify each inquiry as emergency, urgent, quote, or routine. Ask only for missing safety details, property address, and callback number. Route emergency issues immediately.
prompts.outcome: Every new request gets sorted before the office loses time.

prompts.title: Quote Follow-Up Agent
prompts.subtitle: Recover open estimates
prompts.pre: You are the Quote Follow-Up Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Write a concise follow-up for an open electrical estimate. Reference the job type, remind the customer of safety/value, and offer two scheduling windows.
prompts.outcome: More $1,000 jobs move from estimate to scheduled work.

prompts.title: Technician Scheduling Agent
prompts.subtitle: Plan daily job flow
prompts.pre: You are the Technician Scheduling Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Given job type, drive time, technician skill, and urgency, recommend a daily schedule that minimizes travel and protects emergencies.
prompts.outcome: The team completes more jobs with less coordination.

cta_personal: Billy, your best first move is not a giant AI overhaul. It is a focused system that protects urgent electrical calls, follows up on estimates, and gives your office time back.

calc.sub: Use these numbers as the Billy Bob Electric baseline: $1,000 average customer value, 160 monthly leads, 35% close rate, and 35 weekly admin hours.

prompt_1: You are a speed-to-lead response agent for Billy Bob Electric. Classify electrical inquiries by urgency and draft a direct response within 60 seconds.
prompt_2: You are a quote follow-up agent for Billy Bob Electric. Draft a customer-specific follow-up for an open estimate and offer two scheduling windows.
prompt_3: You are an outreach agent for Billy Bob Electric. Generate local referral and review request messages for completed electrical jobs.

ai_agents.name: Emergency Dispatch Agent
ai_agents.desc: When a homeowner calls with a power outage, tripped breaker, or sparking outlet, this agent captures the inquiry via web form or text, assesses urgency, and immediately dispatches the nearest available technician with a pre-filled job ticket.
ai_agents.prompt: You are an emergency dispatch agent for Billy Bob Electric. When an emergency electrical inquiry arrives, assess urgency (sparking, no power, burning smell = P1), look up available technicians, create a dispatch ticket with job details and customer address, and send an ETA text to the customer within 2 minutes.
ai_agents.result: Emergency jobs dispatched in under 2 minutes — before the customer calls a competitor.

ai_agents.name: Quote Follow-Up Agent
ai_agents.desc: Tracks every open estimate and automatically follows up at 24h, 72h, and 7 days with a personalized message referencing the specific job (panel upgrade, EV charger, etc.) and offering to answer questions or schedule.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a quote follow-up agent for Billy Bob Electric. Review open estimates in the CRM, identify which are past 24h/72h/7d milestones, and send personalized follow-up texts/emails referencing the specific job type and estimated cost. Offer to schedule or answer questions. Update CRM on each touchpoint.
ai_agents.result: Converts 20-30% more estimates into booked jobs without any staff effort.

ai_agents.name: Technician Scheduling Agent
ai_agents.desc: Matches new service requests to available technicians based on location, job type, and current workload. Automatically sends appointment confirmations and 1-hour-ahead reminders to customers.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a technician scheduling agent for Billy Bob Electric. When a new job is booked, check technician calendars and proximity, assign the best match, send a calendar invite to the tech, and text the customer a confirmation with tech name, arrival window, and a reminder 1 hour before.
ai_agents.result: Zero scheduling gaps — every available slot filled, zero missed appointments.

ai_agents.name: Permit & Inspection Prep Agent
ai_agents.desc: For panel upgrades, EV charger installs, and new construction work that requires permits, this agent prepares the permit application package and schedules the inspection appointment with the local building department.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a permit preparation agent for Billy Bob Electric. For jobs requiring permits (panel upgrades, new circuits, EV chargers), gather job details from the work order, pre-fill the permit application for the relevant jurisdiction, attach required documentation, and queue it for submission. Schedule inspection as soon as permit is issued.
ai_agents.result: Permits filed same day — no more week-long delays waiting for paperwork.

ai_agents.name: Maintenance Plan Agent
ai_agents.desc: Identifies customers who have not had an electrical safety inspection in 2+ years and sends personalized outreach offering an annual electrical health check — generating recurring revenue without any new marketing spend.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a maintenance plan agent for Billy Bob Electric. Query the CRM for customers with no service in 18+ months, segment by home age and prior job type, and send a personalized safety inspection offer referencing their last service. Log all outreach and responses. Offer scheduling directly in the message.
ai_agents.result: Reactivates dormant customers — 15-25% response rate, zero ad spend.

ai_agents.name: Review & Referral Agent
ai_agents.desc: Sends a review request 2 hours after job completion with a direct Google review link. For customers who leave 5-star reviews, automatically sends a referral discount offer for their next service or for a friend.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a review and referral agent for Billy Bob Electric. After a job is marked complete, wait 2 hours and send a personalized thank-you text with a direct Google review link. If the customer posts a 4-5 star review, send a referral offer within 24 hours. Log all interactions and referral conversions in CRM.
ai_agents.result: Doubles Google review volume — referrals generate 2-3 jobs per month.
